newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 21. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 21. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Chechnya is to open a representative office in Saudi Arabia.
- Indian teams are visiting morgues in Saudi Arabia to identify bodies as part of their efforts to find out how many Indian haj pilgrims are missing, dead, or injured.
- Saudi Arabian Fertiliser Company (corrects company name from Arabian Cement) posted net profits of 146 million riyals in the first quarter of 1997.
- Saudi businessmen invest in 15 projects in Egypt.
- Western Province electricity company is to undertake new projects to cover the region's electricity needs.
